greeting: Welcome to the café! Pull up a chair. What would you like to talk about?

townTopics.question: What can I explore around town?
townTopics.answer: Meet Milo and Ivy, stroll through the photo park, or visit the arcade for a game. Take your time!

townTopics.question: Can I just take a break here?
townTopics.answer: Of course! Pick a seat, take a breather, and head back out whenever you’re ready.
